court_cases.status: Early procedural order; underlying dispute appears to be a cheque-dishonour / recovery matter (Indian Kanoon AI tag 'cheque-dishonour' on the result set). Not a criminal conviction of the company.

news_risk: No negative news, regulator action or enforcement item found. Searches for the exact entity name returned only unrelated 'Multichem' brand companies (UK inks maker Multichem Ltd, Singapore Multi-Chem, Multichem Corporation, Multichem Group, Sterling Multi-Chem, Halliburton Multi-Chem) — none of these are the subject entity and must not be conflated with it. No RBI/SEBI/MCA/ED/IT enforcement item located.
note: Sanctions: screened against OpenSanctions consolidated dataset (OFAC SDN, UN, EU, UK, BIS and others; data current as of 2026-11-28) for both 'Multichem Specialities' and the partial 'Multichem' — 'No matching entities were found' in either query. No sanctions exposure identified. Court: the company is a repeat litigant at Bombay High Court, but in the role of applicant/appellant pursuing a commercial claim (leave to appeal, cheque-dishonour/recovery context) — i.e. it is the party seeking relief, not a defendant in a criminal matter. Per project rule 2 this is noted neutrally and is not a rejection ground. Credit rating: no public rating found (null) — the company does not appear in CRISIL/ICRA/CARE/India Ratings public lists that were reachable; absence of a rating is not evidence of weakness. RF/CIS supply: no evidence found either way (null) — no customs, B/L, contract or media record linking this entity to Russia or CIS buyers was located; this is an absence of public evidence, not a confirmed negative. Research limitation to flag: the web_search backend was down (connection refused) for the whole session and Google returned HTTP 429, so discovery relied on Bing plus direct reads of OpenSanctions and Indian Kanoon. Bing repeatedly ignored exact-phrase operators and served cached generic 'Multichem' results, so negative findings on news/regulator actions are weaker than a full-text search would give. Recommend a paid registry/news pass (Tofler/Zauba, MCA, Dow Jones/Factiva) before final sign-off. No PAN, CIN or registration number was asserted anywhere in this record because none was publicly confirmed.
